entries.name: Patient Maw

counterPressure.note: One on-hit control rider held at the family's own low band, plus a single low maxHp Increased line and nothing else raw. A heirloom-rung main-hand rolls 3-4 affixes across tiers 3-5; this carries one modest stat line and a control verb the pool cannot draw for this role.

entries.flavor: It has not fired in a season. It has not needed to - nothing that reaches this line leaves thinking clearly.
entries.notes: Role armament-primary, axis control per the corpus-wide allocation table. baseType item.plant-muzzle-b-005 ('Venting Spitter', class nozzle, weapon.plant.nozzle ladder). atom.mesmerizing kept at its own shipped low band deliberately - its family notes flag hypno as the strongest single thing a status can do and ask that a chance-based rider never compound past low. Name: compound, adjective 'Patient' from themeAdjectivePools['earthen-bastion'], noun 'Maw' from nounPools['armament-primary.plant'].

entries.name: Bole of the Redoubt

counterPressure.note: One reactive status-clear rider and a single low maxHp Increased line - no offense line at all. A heirloom-rung torso rolls 3-4 affixes across tiers 3-5; this spends its whole fixed core on holding the line clean and upright.

entries.flavor: The wall that held longest was never the tallest one. It was the one nothing behind it ever had to explain.
entries.notes: Role core-guard, axis utility. baseType item.plant-stem-b-007 ('Dense Trunk', class heartwood, armour.plant.heartwood ladder). atom.cleansing is status.clear/OnDamageTaken per g-sustain.json, cat U - strips a harmful status every time the wearer is struck, which is what makes this a utility-axis pick despite sitting on a core-guard body. Name: of-construct, noun 'Bole' from nounPools['core-guard.plant'], concept 'Redoubt' from conceptPools['earthen-bastion'].

entries.name: Stonebed

counterPressure.note: One on-kill sun rider and a single low maxHp Flat line - no defense stat and no offense stat at all. A firstseed-rung shoulder-piece rolls 4-5 affixes across tiers 3-5; this spends its fixed core entirely on keeping the garden behind the line fed.

entries.flavor: Plant here once, and the ground remembers the shape of the root long after the root itself is gone.
entries.notes: Role ward-array, axis economy. baseType item.plant-sheath-b-008 ('Hoary Armature', class heartwood, armour.plant.heartwood ladder). atom.sunbloom (resource.economy, cat E) grants sun on kill - a rule break by the exemplar's own precedent, since g-economy.json's roles list is girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor, never ward-array; a unique's fixed core is not drawn from the role pool, so the break costs the architecture nothing. Name: whole-token fusion from uniqueSetSeedPools['earthen-bastion'] (canonicalId 'stonebed'), used atomically per naming.v1.json's fusion pattern.

entries.name: Buried Caltrop

counterPressure.note: Reflects damage back at whatever struck the wearer rather than dealing any of its own - no might or ferocity line at all, just one low maxHp Increased line beside it. A firstseed off-hand rolls 4-5 affixes across tiers 3-5; this never initiates.

entries.flavor: It does not swing. It waits under the soil for the line to be crossed, and crossing it is the whole mistake.
entries.notes: Role armament-secondary, axis offense. baseType item.plant-thorn-b-004 ('Hardened Goad', class thornguard, offhand.plant.thornguard ladder). atom.retribution (resource.delta/OnDamageTaken, cat O) is the offense-axis capability, framed as pure reprisal rather than an initiated strike - deliberately away from the 'offense-first framing' themes.v1.json asks earthen-bastion to avoid, while still sitting on the O power category the corpus allocation requires for this slot. Name: compound, adjective 'Buried' from themeAdjectivePools['earthen-bastion'], noun 'Caltrop' from nounPools['armament-secondary.plant'].

entries.name: Corymb of the Subsoil

counterPressure.note: One earth-shield-on-spawn rider and a single low maxHp Flat line, both survivability and nothing else - no offense, no control, no economy. A heirloom-rung neck-slot rolls 3-4 affixes across tiers 3-5; this is a wall around one stat and stops there.

entries.flavor: Pollen falls where it falls. This much of it took root in ground packed hard enough to hold.
entries.notes: Role jewel-major, axis survivability. baseType item.plant-pollen-b-007 ('Cohered Pistil', class graft, jewel.plant.graft ladder). atom.warded is element-variant (variants.generate = elements+omni per g-sustain.json), so params.element is authored here as 'earth' to match theme.earthen-bastion's elementAffinity, the same pattern the exemplar's atom.searing-strike entry uses for its own variant family. Name: of-construct, noun 'Corymb' from nounPools['jewel-major.plant'], concept 'Subsoil' from conceptPools['earthen-bastion'].

entries.name: Walled Whorl

counterPressure.note: One on-hit poison rider and a single low Flat-attack line - no survivability and no economy line at all. A firstseed-rung hand-slot rolls 4-5 affixes across tiers 3-5; this locks onto one control verb and one small number.

entries.flavor: Close a hand around it, and the hand does not open again on its own terms.
entries.notes: Role manipulator, axis control. baseType item.plant-leaves-b-006 ('Stony Whorl', class heartwood, armour.plant.heartwood ladder). atom.venomous (status.apply/poison, per g-affliction.json) is legal on manipulator directly - one of the seven roles its own roles list already names, so no rule-break is needed here, only the axis allocation. Name: compound, adjective 'Walled' from themeAdjectivePools['earthen-bastion'], noun 'Whorl' from nounPools['manipulator.plant'].

entries.name: Longhold

counterPressure.note: Both fixed lines sit at the family's own low band - a modest on-death spawn chance and one small maxHp Increased line, no offense stat of any kind. A heirloom-rung back-slot rolls 3-4 affixes across tiers 3-5; this keeps its whole fixed core deliberately small.

entries.flavor: When it finally falls, something is already growing where it stood.
entries.notes: Role mantle, axis utility. baseType item.plant-canopy-b-004 ('Ancient Bough', class heartwood, armour.plant.heartwood ladder). atom.gardener (spawn.entity/OnDeath, cat U per atom-family-library.md §3.5) is the rule-break here - g-on-death.json's roles list never includes mantle, and a unique's fixed core is not drawn from that pool, so the break costs nothing mechanically. Name: whole-token fusion from uniqueSetSeedPools['earthen-bastion'] (canonicalId 'longhold').

entries.name: Cone of the Embankment

counterPressure.note: One on-deployment points rider and a single low maxHp Increased line - no offense and no control line at all. A firstseed-rung head-slot rolls 4-5 affixes across tiers 3-5; this never spends a slot on damage.

entries.flavor: It counts what the wall costs to hold, and it has never once come out ahead - until this season.
entries.notes: Role head-guard, axis economy. baseType item.plant-crown-b-006 ('Hoary Cone', class bark, armour.plant.bark ladder). atom.econ-muster (resource.economy/OnSpawn, per g-economy.json) is a rule break the same shape as Stonebed's above - its roles list is girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor, never head-guard, and a unique's fixed core sidesteps the pool entirely. Name: of-construct, noun 'Cone' from nounPools['head-guard.plant'], concept 'Embankment' from conceptPools['earthen-bastion'].
